title: Associate Product Manager
summary: Builder PM and CS grad (Summer 2026) who ships full-stack MVPs by directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex), managing all feature and bug work as structured Linear issues connected via MCP. Directed CI/CD deployment automation through GitHub Actions across 3 environments to a Google Cloud VM at 99% uptime. Turns recurring customer problems into scoped product requirements, and communicates decision-ready material to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong in discovery, MVP scoping, and translating ambiguous objectives into shipped, measurable outcomes.

Scout: Drove product discovery and requirements definition for an early-stage startup, translating ambiguous objectives into structured problem statements, MVP scope, and prioritized backlogs.
Delivered 20+ high-fidelity screens across onboarding, discovery, and profile flows within a 2-week sprint, maintaining stakeholder alignment and on-time demo readiness.
Synthesized feedback across 2+ sprint cycles to balance user needs with technical feasibility, collaborating with 3 to 5 cross-functional teammates.
